raw_block.rationale: Create a grounded airline calculator that leaves only source-specific classification and fee-table extraction to one joint reader, while deterministically assigning checked-bag positions and applying the higher of oversize and overweight charges. This directly targets both failed airline parents and can also improve the history airline parent without encoding any case answer.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What integer ticket price is stated for the current passenger?

inputs.name: dimension_totals
inputs.question: For every current item in fact order, what is its total outside dimension in inches, calculated as length plus width plus height?

inputs.name: weights
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, what is its weight in pounds?

inputs.name: is_free_carryon
inputs.question: For every current item in the same order, does it qualify as a permitted carry-on or personal item that is not treated as a checked bag?

inputs.name: checked_base_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route, cabin, and complimentary-bag status, what are the integer base fees for the first, second, third, and fourth-or-later checked bags, in that order?

inputs.name: oversize_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route, what are the integer oversize fees for bags over 62 through 65 total inches and over 65 through 115 total inches, in that order?

inputs.name: overweight_fee_schedule
inputs.question: For the current route and cabin, what are the integer overweight fees for bags over 50 through 53 pounds, over 53 through 70 pounds, and over 70 through 100 pounds, in that order?

skill.intent: Compute the exact integer ticket-plus-bag total for a current itinerary from the passenger's bags and the route-and-cabin fee schedules stated in the current source.

outputs.description: The exact integer ticket price plus all current checked-bag base fees and applicable higher-of-size-or-weight surcharges.
outputs.name: answer

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What is the stated integer ticket price?

fields.name: dimension_totals
fields.question: What are the aligned length-plus-width-plus-height totals for all listed items?

fields.name: weights
fields.question: What are the aligned weights in pounds for all listed items?

fields.name: is_free_carryon
fields.question: Which aligned items qualify as permitted carry-on or personal items rather than checked bags?

fields.name: checked_base_fee_schedule
fields.question: What four-position checked-bag base-fee schedule applies after route, cabin, and complimentary-bag rules?

fields.name: oversize_fee_schedule
fields.question: What two oversize-tier fees apply to the current route?

fields.name: overweight_fee_schedule
fields.question: What three overweight-tier fees apply to the current route and cabin?

reads.question: Read the current passenger, itinerary, item measurements, carry-on eligibility, complimentary allowance, and applicable route-and-cabin fee-table entries as one aligned bag-fee record.
